title: Learner 01 | Day 094: Embeddings and vector indexes
body:
## Goal

Implement fake deterministic embeddings for offline work and a provider adapter; store model and dimension with vectors.

## Learn this first

An embedding maps content to a numeric vector. A vector index searches nearby vectors using a chosen distance measure.

## Method signature and expected behavior

**File:** `src/learnforge/core/operations/retrieval.py`

**Function/class/value to change:** `apply_embedding_index`

**Why here:** This is a domain/application decision: it expresses the calculation or use-case behavior while depending on values and small collaborator contracts.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Dimension mismatch is rejected; model-version change creates a new index version rather than mixing vectors.

**Boundaries:** Apply the rule once; use accepted values, not transport parsing or printing.

## Research hints

1. Research **Embeddings and vector indexes**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:huggingface.co/docs Embeddings and vector indexes`; use [Hugging Face LLM course](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1) for the relevant small section.
